claim: Read the interrupt flag with LD A,I twice (ld a,i / jp pe,ok / ld a,i), because a single read can be wrong on NMOS Z80s; the toolkit's IFF audit rejects a single read.

evidence.text: 'show' first trusted one LD A,I; review caught it, hooklib.iff_audit now says twice.
Two single LD A,I reads in 1.2 failed the IFF audit; 1.3 calls iff_off at both, which reads twice.
